hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); FILE=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // (.tool_input.edits[0].file_path // empty)' 2>/dev/null); case "$FILE" in *.env|*.env.*|*credentials*|*secret*|*.pem|*.key|*id_rsa*) echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"🔒 Sensitive file protected by this hook. Edit it by hand if it is really needed."}}'; exit 0;; .git/*|.claude/settings.json) echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"🔒 Configuration file protected."}}'; exit 0;; esac

bash -c 'MEMORY_BRIDGE="$HOME/dotfiles/scripts/memory_bridge.py"; if [ -f "$MEMORY_BRIDGE" ]; then CONTEXT=$(python3 "$MEMORY_BRIDGE" query --text "$(basename $PWD) project context" --top-k 5 --project "$(basename $PWD)" --format plain 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$CONTEXT" ]; then echo "Memory context injected: $CONTEXT"; fi; fi'

echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreCompact","additionalContext":"POST-COMPACTION REMINDER: Respond in English. Lint and protection hooks are active. Agents: frontend, backend, database, architect, devops, security. Skills: /review, /ship, /refactor, /test, /security, /debug."}}'

bash -c 'MEMORY_BRIDGE="$HOME/dotfiles/scripts/memory_bridge.py"; if [ -f "$MEMORY_BRIDGE" ]; then python3 "$MEMORY_BRIDGE" store --text "PreCompact session context for $(basename $PWD)" --tags "session,precompact" --project "$(basename $PWD)" --quiet 2>/dev/null; fi'

INPUT=$(cat); ACTIVE=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.stop_hook_active' 2>/dev/null); [ "$ACTIVE" = "true" ] && exit 0; MSG=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.last_assistant_message // empty' 2>/dev/null); echo "$MSG" | grep -qi 'todo\|fixme' && echo '{"continue":true,"stopReason":"Pending items (TODO/FIXME) appear in the response. Check whether you want to continue."}' || exit 0

bash -c 'MEMORY_DIR="$HOME/memory"; if [ -d "$MEMORY_DIR/.git" ]; then cd "$MEMORY_DIR" && git add -A && git diff --cached --quiet || git commit -m "session-end: $(date +%Y-%m-%d-%H%M) $(basename $OLDPWD)" --quiet 2>/dev/null; fi'
